partners.mechanism_chain: RHOA (HGNC:9994) —DISRUPTS→ RHOA signaling pathway (WP:WP499); RHOA signaling pathway (WP:WP499) —DISRUPTS→ Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030039); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030039) —LEADS_TO→ Facial dysmorphism (HP:0001949); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030039) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal brain morphology (HP:0011032); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030039) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormalities of the extremities (HP:0009776); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030039) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal ocular morphology (HP:0000473). Loss-of-function mutations in RHOA disrupt its signaling pathway, which in turn impairs actin cytoskeleton organization. This disruption leads to a shared set of developmental abnormalities including facial dysmorphism, abnormal brain morphology, limb anomalies, and ocular defects, manifesting as distinct but mechanistically related rare diseases.
